title: Individuals who have Leveraged on Global Investor Programme to Qualify for Permanent Residency
what_it_is: Individuals who have Leveraged on Global Investor Programme to Qualify for Permanent Residency

sections.label: GIP investor business expenditure
sections.summary: GIP investors brought over S$5.46 billion in business expenditure, generating over 24,000 jobs, and injected S$1.62 billion into approved GIP funds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The GIP investors brought in more than S$5.46 billion in total business expenditure via direct investments.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is generating more than 24,000 jobs in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As of October 2022, GIP investors have also injected S$1.62 billion into approved GIP funds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Of this S$1.62 billion, the fund managers have deployed 87.2% and this translates to S$1.41 billion into actual investments.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: If I could provide a further breakdown – 65.6% of this S$1.41 billion, which is S$930 million, has been invested in Singapore-based companies.

sections.label: GIP investors under PR scheme
sections.summary: From 2020 to 2022, about 200 GIP investors were approved under the PR scheme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As I have shared in my answer to the Parliamentary Question earlier, over the past three years, 2020 to 2022, we approved about 200 GIP investors to be under the PR scheme.

sections.label: GIP PRs granted citizenship
sections.summary: A very, very low percentage of PRs under the GIP has been granted Singapore Citizenship.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As for his question on Singapore Citizenship, I can say that a very, very low percentage of the PRs under the GIP has been granted citizenship.

sections.label: GIP PRs share of total
sections.summary: GIP investors approved as PRs are much lesser than 1% of total PRs approved each year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: GIP investors who are approved as PRs are much lesser than 1% of the total number of PRs approved each year.
